2026-10-23FIN, MINTRoyal Canadian Mint ActOrder Authorizing the Issue, Specifying the Characteristics and Determining the Design of Two Circulation Coins (New Composition)Order Authorizing the Issue, Specifying the Characteristics and Determining the Design of Two Circulation Coins (New Composition) in order to approve the designs bearing the enhanced security features which will include (1) one-dollar coin: sixty-seven beads and ten maple leaves; a pulsating maple leaf near the top; and, beneath the loon, a dynamic surface texture giving the appearance of shimmering water; and (2) two-dollar coin: two virtual images of a maple leaf that appear as the number “2” when the coin is tilted; two pulsating maple leaves; and on the left-hand and right-hand side of the year of issue would appear a new maple leaf struck in positive relief within which the word “CANADA” is repeated in micro-text.Registration: SOR/2026-0225 Publication Date: 2026-11-04
subject: Order Authorizing the Issue, Specifying the Characteristics and Determining the Design of Two Circulation Coins (New Composition)
precis: Order Authorizing the Issue, Specifying the Characteristics and Determining the Design of Two Circulation Coins (New Composition) in order to approve the designs bearing the enhanced security features which will include (1) one-dollar coin: sixty-seven beads and ten maple leaves; a pulsating maple leaf near the top; and, beneath the loon, a dynamic surface texture giving the appearance of shimmering water; and (2) two-dollar coin: two virtual images of a maple leaf that appear as the number “2” when the coin is tilted; two pulsating maple leaves; and on the left-hand and right-hand side of the year of issue would appear a new maple leaf struck in positive relief within which the word “CANADA” is repeated in micro-text.
